probe: SELECT PRODUCT AS "product", VERSION_FULL AS "version", SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','CON_NAME') AS "catalog" FROM PRODUCT_COMPONENT_VERSION WHERE PRODUCT LIKE 'Oracle%Database%'

queries.sql: SELECT OWNER AS "schema",TABLE_NAME AS "name" FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER=:scope ORDER BY TABLE_NAME

SELECT OWNER AS "schema",TABLE_NAME AS "name",COLUMN_NAME AS "column_name",CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('VARCHAR2','CHAR','NVARCHAR2','NCHAR') THEN DATA_TYPE || '(' || CHAR_LENGTH || CASE CHAR_USED WHEN 'C' THEN ' CHAR' ELSE ' BYTE' END || ')' WHEN DATA_TYPE='NUMBER' AND DATA_PRECISION IS NOT NULL THEN DATA_TYPE || '(' || DATA_PRECISION || ',' || NVL(DATA_SCALE,0) || ')' ELSE DATA_TYPE END AS "data_type",COLUMN_ID AS "ordinal",NULLABLE AS "nullable" FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE OWNER=:scope AND TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES t WHERE t.OWNER=ALL_TAB_COLUMNS.OWNER) ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_ID

SELECT c.OWNER AS "schema",c.TABLE_NAME AS "name",c.CONSTRAINT_NAME AS "constraint_name",CASE c.CONSTRAINT_TYPE WHEN 'P' THEN 'primary_key' WHEN 'R' THEN 'foreign_key' WHEN 'U' THEN 'unique' WHEN 'C' THEN 'check' END AS "constraint_kind",k.COLUMN_NAME AS "column_name",rc.OWNER AS "ref_schema",rc.TABLE_NAME AS "ref_table",rk.COLUMN_NAME AS "ref_column" FROM ALL_CONSTRAINTS c LEFT JOIN ALL_CONS_COLUMNS k ON k.OWNER=c.OWNER AND k.CONSTRAINT_NAME=c.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN ALL_CONSTRAINTS rc ON rc.OWNER=c.R_OWNER AND rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME=c.R_CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN ALL_CONS_COLUMNS rk ON rk.OWNER=rc.OWNER AND rk.CONSTRAINT_NAME=rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND rk.POSITION=k.POSITION WHERE c.OWNER=:scope AND c.CONSTRAINT_TYPE IN ('P','R','U','C') ORDER BY c.TABLE_NAME,c.CONSTRAINT_NAME,k.POSITION

SELECT i.OWNER AS "schema",i.INDEX_NAME AS "name",i.TABLE_NAME AS "table_name",c.COLUMN_NAME AS "column_name",CASE i.UNIQUENESS WHEN 'UNIQUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_unique" FROM ALL_INDEXES i LEFT JOIN ALL_IND_COLUMNS c ON c.INDEX_OWNER=i.OWNER AND c.INDEX_NAME=i.INDEX_NAME WHERE i.OWNER=:scope ORDER BY i.INDEX_NAME,c.COLUMN_POSITION
SELECT OWNER AS "schema",VIEW_NAME AS "name" FROM ALL_VIEWS WHERE OWNER=:scope ORDER BY VIEW_NAME
SELECT LOWER(OBJECT_TYPE) AS "object_kind",OWNER AS "schema",OBJECT_NAME AS "name" FROM ALL_OBJECTS WHERE OWNER=:scope AND OBJECT_TYPE IN ('FUNCTION','PROCEDURE','PACKAGE') ORDER BY OBJECT_NAME
SELECT OWNER AS "schema",TRIGGER_NAME AS "name" FROM ALL_TRIGGERS WHERE OWNER=:scope ORDER BY TRIGGER_NAME
SELECT OWNER AS "schema",TABLE_NAME AS "name",NUM_ROWS AS "value",TO_CHAR(LAST_ANALYZED,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "updated_at" FROM ALL_TAB_STATISTICS WHERE OWNER=:scope AND OBJECT_TYPE='TABLE'
SELECT USER AS "schema",SEGMENT_NAME AS "name",SUM(BYTES) AS "value" FROM USER_SEGMENTS WHERE USER=:scope GROUP BY SEGMENT_NAME
queries.empty_reason: owner-only USER_SEGMENTS: requested owner may differ from connected user, or own segments are absent
